title: MonoGuard — frequency-dependent coherence, protection mode
description:
Implement Mono Guard frequency-dependent L/R coherence analysis and optional protection mode per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §11.2. Depends on MidSideRouter existing so protection can reason about side-domain boosts without secretly embedding a second M/S matrix.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §11.2 (S_LR, rho(f); warn or limit excessive side boosts only when protection enabled; no silent alteration when protection off)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §11.3 (no delay-based width/decorrelation)
- Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.* encode domain and side path from h.1 (read only; may accept mid/side or L/R buffers)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.* if spectral bins help coherence estimates (read only optional; MonoGuard may use lighter band-wise correlation instead)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h monoGuardEnabled / monoGuardProtection if present (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; h.5 owns registration)

Implement Source/DSP/MonoGuard.h and Source/DSP/MonoGuard.cpp:
1. Frequency-dependent coherence:
   S_LR(f) = E[X_L(f) * conj(X_R(f))]
   rho(f) = Re(S_LR(f)) / (sqrt(S_LL(f)*S_RR(f)) + eps)
   Document band/bin resolution (fixed ERB/octave or FFT bins with fixed prep memory).
2. prepare/reset; push or process stereo blocks updating smoothed band-wise rho without heap on audio thread when analysis path is engaged.
3. Warning path (default when enabled analysis but protection off): expose per-band risk flags / rho snapshot getters for GUI; do NOT alter audio.
4. Protection mode (only when user enables): limit excessive side energy/boosts in low-coherence (unstable / cancellation-risk) regions — e.g. cap side gain or attenuate side in bands where rho is near 0 or negative and proposed side boost exceeds a threshold. Never secretly engage protection when flag is off.
5. APIs: setEnabled, setProtectionEnabled, getRho / getRiskMask, process or analyze+maybeProtect on side or L/R buffers. Coordinate with MidSideRouter by operating on Side after encode when available without re-encoding.
6. True bypass of protection when disabled: analysis may still update meters if enabled, but audio path identity preserved when protection false.
7. Fixed memory; finite guards; zero intentional latency.
8. No PluginProcessor, CMakeLists, Lookahead, SidechainAnalyzer rewrites, or tests in this task.

C++20/JUCE style consistent with Source/. verification_commands left empty.
acceptance_criteria: MonoGuard estimates frequency-dependent rho(f) using S_LR / sqrt(S_LL*S_RR)+eps style coherence per §11.2
With protection disabled, audio is unaltered while risk/rho diagnostics remain readable
With protection enabled, excessive side energy in low-coherence bands is limited/bounded without heap in process
No secret protection when the protection flag is off; zero intentional latency
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: engage audible protection without an explicit protection-enabled flag

allowed: fixed band-wise running correlation without full STFT if simpler
optional light use of spectral magnitudes with fixed bins
side-gain cap or side HPF-band attenuation only under protection
operate on Side buffer after MidSideRouter encode
